body.message:
We sincerely apologies for the inconvenience caused.

We can see that you have extended your booking for 2 nights, and this reflects the same rate you have already been paying. For this reason, we have continued to apply the same rate.

As a long-stay guest, we have offered you our most competitive rate. Please note that the standard system rate for this apartment is AED 581 per night, which is shared for your information only.

However, we have maintained your existing rate as you are a long-stay guest.

Once again, we truly apologise for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you for your understanding
